output_list.criticism: The token devalue vulnerability is caused by the following function: MyAdvancedToken. The function allows the owner to mint more tokens than the total supply. This can be exploited by the attacker to mint more tokens than the total supply and then sell them at a lower price. The attacker will have more tokens than the total supply and the total supply will be less than the initial supply. The attacker will be able to sell the tokens at a loss. The attacker can use the following code to exploit the vulnerability: MyAdvancedToken token = new MyAdvancedToken(1000000000000000000000000000,
